findings.body: The result refinement validates row keys, coordinates, values, and coverage, but never checks `actual.drilldownId` or `availableActualSubtotal.drilldownId` uniqueness across totals and rows. Two different GL/month/component cells can therefore validate with the same opaque handle, causing at least one clickable Actual to open transactions for the wrong scope. Track handles while iterating value sets, reject reuse across distinct scopes, and add a negative result-validation case.
findings.title: Not done: distinct Actual scopes require distinct drill handles

findings.body: Every result dimension is nullable, while the special Unmapped rules activate only for the exact `unmapped-GL` coordinate. Consequently a component-grouped row with `nursery_component: null` validates as an ordinary mapped component and may carry numeric Budget and percentage values. Known-Plant Actuals without a component mapping must instead use the governed Unmapped coordinate, with no Budget allocation and a Not applicable percentage. Reject null component coordinates and add a regression covering this bypass.
findings.title: Not done: nullable component rows cannot bypass the Unmapped contract
